corpus.distinct_task_definition: one admitted task id bound to one public contract and one source commit; repetitions do not create distinct tasks
corpus.selection_order: ascending(repository_url, source_commit, task_id) from a preregistered candidate list
corpus.pre_outcome_replacement: next eligible task in the same stratum
corpus.post_outcome_changes: no add, remove, substitute, or relabel
corpus.execution_freeze: both strata meet threshold, every W1-EXP-01a admission check passes, exact expanded root is recorded, and owner approves that root

conditions.purpose: independent search with blinded artifact selection
locally negotiated coordination without prescribed roles or plan

randomization.condition_assignment: all three conditions exactly once per block
randomization.launch_order: SHA-256 domain ymp-study-order-v1 over manifest digest, task id, and repetition
randomization.seed_assignment: SHA-256 domain ymp-study-seed-v1 over manifest digest, task id, repetition, and condition
randomization.runtime_profile_balance: predeclared digest order, identical exact profile and its one bound model route in all three arms of a block
randomization.runtime_profile_admission: separate W1-EXP-01d capability matrix must prove exact version, configuration isolation, usage, cost, retry identity, and cancellation before primary collection

power.minimum_effect_interpretation: one additional independently accepted result per eight matched task opportunities
power.sample_size_method: distribution-free Hoeffding fixed-sample bound for paired task-cluster differences in [-1,1], testing the 0.125 boundary against a 0.25 alternative

resources.reservation_rule: reserve a complete per-call maximum before start
resources.in_flight_overshoot_rule: charge every category and provider cost to the originating arm, stop later starts, retain the assigned outcome

prerandomization_allowed: frozen corpus integrity or admission failure
common disposable environment preflight failure before any arm starts
exact duplicate schedule entry detected before assignment
exclusions.missing_accounting_or_integrity: invalidate comparison; do not delete an arm

outcomes.primary: indicator(terminal_outcome == accepted && exact protected verifier decision == passed)

stopping.run_rule: permitted terminal, any nonexchangeable resource limit, elapsed-time limit, one protected query, or authorized project cancellation
stopping.study_rule: fixed sample; no efficacy, futility, cost, or conditional-power look
stopping.project_currency_ceiling_effect: may prevent a new block before start; cannot erase blocks, change target sample, or authorize a partial positive claim

analysis.primary_estimand: equal-task mean accepted-result probability within each structural stratum
analysis.repetition_treatment: average within task; never count as distinct task
analysis.reporting_interval: distribution-free two-sided 95 percent Hoeffding interval for paired task-cluster differences
analysis.decision_interval: distribution-free one-sided alpha 0.025 Hoeffding bound within each claimable stratum
analysis.support_rule: complete compliant sample; both lower decision bounds exceed 0.125; measurement and audit conditions hold; external owner authorization confirmed
analysis.reject_rule: upper decision bound versus independent_best_of_n below 0.125
analysis.scope_rule: both supported strata permit two-stratum claim; one supported stratum permits only that restricted claim

instrument_reliability.interval: one-sided 97.5 percent for claim conditions; two-sided 95 percent in reports

communication.episode_unit: at most one mechanically selected message episode per distinct task
communication.episode_selection: smallest SHA-256 over manifest digest, task id, and eligible message id without content or outcome
communication.endpoint_freeze: typed receiver next-action endpoint committed before fresh intervention runs
